items.text: Indian rules treat blindness and low vision as two different categories.
CBSE's circular of 24 January 2017 lists these facilities for visually impaired candidates.
The routes are ordered by how far visible skill can lift income, with rank-based routes last.
Screen-reader based work is common in software and testing roles, and clients pay for finished, working products.
Who pays you Software firms, startups and clients who need accessible products.

blocks.heading: Compare the Practical Paths
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: School board exams: what CBSE provides

rows: Scribe and extra time
A scribe, extra time or both. For a three-hour paper the extra time is 60 minutes. The candidate may choose their own scribe, and the scribe should not hold qualifications in the subject.
Ask the school to record your choice during registration.
Screen reading software
Permitted, with prior Board approval, and a computer or typewriter may be used to write answers.
Apply for approval early and practise on the exam setup.
Calculators
The circular says calculators are not permitted in any Board examination.
Practise mental and written maths methods.
Fees
The circular says registration and examination fees are not charged from visually impaired students for Classes IX to XII.
Ask the school to confirm for your year.
Question papers (Class X)
Alternative questions replace those with visual input in English Communicative and Social Science. Enlarged print is available in Mathematics and Science.
State large print or alternative questions in your request.
Science practicals (Class XII)
Separate multiple-choice papers replace practicals in Physics, Chemistry and Biology, and the papers in those subjects and Mathematics carry no visual input.
Check how the practical marks are given in your subject.

blocks.heading: Entrance and Recruitment Exams
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Entrance and recruitment exams: scribes and extra time

rows: Court order on UPSC prelims for visually impaired candidates, 19 August 2014

Compensatory time should not be less than 20 minutes per hour for candidates using a scribe. Candidates not using a scribe should get at least one extra hour on a three-hour paper. Candidates may choose the mode, including Braille, computer, large print or recorded answers, and low-vision candidates may ask for larger print.
DEPwD Office Memorandum of 10 August 2022

For persons with specified disabilities who have difficulty in writing, compensatory time of not less than 20 minutes per hour. A candidate may choose their own scribe or ask the exam body for one. The own scribe should be one step below the candidate's qualification.
Supreme Court, Gulshan Kumar v. IBPS (3 February 2025)
The Court said denying a scribe or compensatory time constitutes discrimination under the RPwD Act, 2016, and directed the ministry to revisit and re-notify the 2022 memorandum.

blocks.heading: Courses and Fields: What to Check
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Courses and fields: what to check

rows: Medicine (MBBS)

The NMC's 2026 guidelines for admission of candidates with benchmark disabilities describe a competency-based, function-oriented assessment. They say no one is declared eligible or ineligible solely on category or percentage, and ineligibility must be decided after reasonable accommodation, with written reasons.
Read the current NMC guidelines and the counselling instructions, and ask for the functional assessment early.
Software, data and accessibility testing

EnAble India lists software developer, technical writer, database administrator and customer service among roles held by visually impaired professionals. A 2017 article described Nabet India training and placing over 500 visually impaired people, including in accessibility testing.
Check that the tools you need work with a screen reader and that the employer supports it.
Banking and government posts
Government reservation is 4 percent, with 1 percent for blindness and low vision, and it applies only to posts identified as suitable.
Read the identified-post list in each notice.
Law, humanities and teaching
These fields rely on reading, writing, argument and communication, which screen readers and recorded material support.
Check access to digital study material and the exam format.
Music, performance and media
Audio-led skills are a natural fit for some students, and success depends on talent and proof of work.
Build a recorded portfolio and test it with real audiences.
